QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is gated on `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` plus `__GNUC__` or `__ARMCC_VERSION`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is gated on MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros (`__GNUC__`, `__ARMCC_VERSION`). That is the derivation the item describes. It never says "not set in mbedtls_config.h", but the mechanism is named.
